observations.text: Shakiness has now been logged 2 times, and a similar episode was logged on 2026-07-31 with sweating, dizziness and a racing heart noted in that entry.

Logged blood glucose readings show a falling trend, with the latest at 150 mg/dL, about 7% lower than the earlier readings.
